notes: Source: official Logitech "Rally Bar" datasheet (PDF, published July 2025), cross-checked against logitech.com/en-us/shop/p/rallybar.html and logitech.com/en-us/products/video-conferencing/rallybar.html — all consistent. All-in-one video bar (camera + speaker + mic array + compute), desktop/table/wall/cart mounted, not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted. Interfaces per datasheet: "HDMI Out: 2 (up to 1080p)", "HDMI In: 1", "USB 3.0: 3x Type A, 1x Type C", "Network: 10/100/1G Ethernet", "External Mic Input: Yes (proprietary input)". Caveats/inferences: (1) HDMI grade set to hdmi-1.4 by inference — the datasheet does not print a version on the HDMI In/Out spec lines themselves, but lists the bundled cable as "HDMI 1.4 Cable" and caps HDMI Out at 1080p, consistent with HDMI 1.4; a higher-bandwidth HDMI chipset is not indicated anywhere. (2) The External Mic Input (for Rally Mic Pod / Mic Pod Hub / extension cable) is described only as "proprietary input" with no connector type given in the datasheet; connector is set to rj45 as the closest standard id based on the RJ45-style 8P8C jack commonly pictured on Rally Mic Pod cables, but this is not confirmed by the source document and the wiring/signaling is proprietary, not Ethernet. (3) The DC power inlet on the bar itself is not diagrammed in this datasheet (only "DC Cable: 1.5m/4.9 ft" from the external auto-sensing power brick is listed, plus a separate "AC Cable" from brick to wall); connector is set to dc-barrel per standard Logitech video-bar convention, but the exact port label/type was not visually confirmed. (4) Exact rear-panel silkscreen labels (e.g. whether it reads "HDMI IN" vs "CONTENT") could not be confirmed — port names use the datasheet's own field terminology. (5) Rally Bar ships in several SKUs (Graphite 960-001308, White 960-001320, regional variants, TAA-compliant 960-001564) with identical I/O, plus a "Rally Bar No-Radio (USB mode certified only)" SKU (960-001669) that omits WiFi, Bluetooth remote control, and appliance-mode radios — wired I/O ports listed here are unaffected. USB 3.0 and 10/100/1G Ethernet ratings are explicitly stated in the source and are high-confidence; the two inferences above are why overall confidence is medium rather than high.

ports.name: HDMI In
ports.note: Content-sharing input; bundled cable is rated HDMI 1.4 (2m). Input resolution ceiling not explicitly stated by Logitech.

ports.name: USB-A 1
ports.note: Datasheet: "USB 3.0: 3x Type A, 1x Type C" — used for Tap/Tap IP, Mic Pod Hub, peripherals.

ports.name: USB-C
ports.note: USB 3.0; ships with a USB-A to USB-C 3.0 cable (2.2m) for BYOD laptop connection.

ports.name: External Mic Input
ports.note: Proprietary expansion input for Rally Mic Pod / Mic Pod Hub / Mic Pod Extension Cable (supports up to 4 additional pods); Logitech states only "proprietary input", connector id inferred as closest match (RJ45-style jack), not confirmed by source.

ports.name: DC In
ports.note: Powered by an external auto-sensing brick (100-240V AC in via detachable AC cord) delivering 19V/4.74A to the bar over a 1.5m captive DC cable; exact device-side connector not diagrammed in the source datasheet, dc-barrel used as the standard convention for this product line.
